articles.title: XRP has failed to make holders rich like bitcoin and ether. Here’s why
articles.snippet: XRP remains below its 2017-cycle high while bitcoin, ether and other major tokens have surged, enriching their holders.

articles.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
articles.snippet: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

articles.title: Australia’s financial watchdog seeks stiffer rules for crypto exchanges ahead of licensing deadline
articles.snippet: The country’s regulator, ASIC, has proposed tougher rules to protect users’ digital assets, crypto trading and to safeguard the country’s financial stability.

articles.title: Nasdaq-listed Tron sets up $200M ATM share offering to fuel TRX acquisitions
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed treasury company holds about $237 million in TRX tokens and plans to raise additional capital to fund its purchases, alongside its daily accumulation.

articles.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
articles.snippet: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.
